audit.title: Imperial Church order 25 Rimini mechanical map/objective review
audit.scope: Mechanical structure, spatial checks, objective references, text clarity/formatting; not an approval of history, drainage, terrain, native implementation, or gameplay balance.
methods: Read the selected episode at episodes[-1] and its matching campaign blueprint at episodeBlueprints[-1].
Checked geographic coordinates against the repository helper tools/design/geography.py tile_point (WGS84, cosine-corrected longitude, padded square, mapSize-1 = 399).
Checked SVG center conversion with the renderer's factor 650/(size-1) and map origin (55,85); parsed SVG structure and rendered it locally for label/map review.
Computed hub pair distances, destination-zone frame margins, entity and optional placement point bounds, and corridor centerline half-width margins in the declared 0..399 frame.
Compared exact objective requirement IDs, arrival destinations, departure receipt references, resource transactions, and static difficulty budget arithmetic.
limits: Straight polylines and their widths are authored proposals. Their geometry does not prove traversable land, ancient land cover, or a route free of minor channels.
The SVG has no visible water controls or terrain raster. Absence of a line or water polygon is not evidence of dry ground.
Budget values are static estimates. Native implementation, resource access, pathfinding, and game QA remain pending.

counts.notes: Five SVG polylines correspond to the five corridor IDs; circles are hub markers, not destination-zone radii. The broad square is a uniform background, not a terrain or water mask.

projectionAndSpatialChecks.projectionResult: All seven stored hub centers exactly match tile_point(bbox, hub.lonLat, 400) at the stored 0.01-tile precision.

renderedHubRadius.assessment: Approximate visual match; circles depict hub disks, not destination radii.

crossTaskSpatialIntersections.assessment: Optional observation zone includes the starting position of the main account note; task predicate semantics/interaction may make this harmless, but flag the spatial coupling for review.

entities.note: Secondary task worlds are separate from worldContract; their counts must be added to report 21 objects and 16 zones. This is a geometry audit, not a claim that entering a circle automatically completes a task.

optionalTaskCenters.note: Placements are carried by separate secondary objective worlds, not a flat `placement` key in the campaign blueprint. Side 6 uses two observation zones: hub-7 + [0,-8] and hub-3 + [0,8].

corridorWidths.widthCheck: All polyline vertices lie within the tile square; because each segment is linear, axis-aligned frame extrema occur at endpoints. Margin includes half the declared full width.
corridorWidths.waterAndTerrain: No water mask/control appears in this SVG. Corridor width and frame compliance do not certify passage over terrain or water.

observations: Large tile rectangle is visually empty aside from seven hub circles and five direct dashed corridor polylines.
No local landform, road, drainage, coastline, river, water polygon, destination disk, or entity marker is drawn.
Labels and legend remain inside the 1050x850 viewBox. Hub 5's name is split over two adjacent text lines (‘Fictional southeast provision-list’ / ‘court’), but neither is clipped.
Legend says brown dashed lines are proposed land routes, but also says the SVG is not a surveyed path or terrain raster and native footprints/navigation are pending.
The SVG is unchanged by optional subworld regeneration and depicts only the 7 main hubs and 5 main corridors; none of the 9 optional entities or 9 optional zones appears in it.

calculationNotes: The profile's `accessibleWithoutOptionalRewards` fields equal start plus finite gatherable bank minus reserved optional awards: food 1190, wood 720, gold 260, stone 160 at all three levels.

At all levels, accessibleWithoutOptionalRewards equals mandatory deliveries + protected recovery stock + replacement budget + supplyMargins for all four resources. The static skip-all arithmetic is internally consistent; it is not native or gameplay verification.
skipAllOptionalStaticBudget.gameplayStatus: Static budget profile only; no resources gathered, objectives played, or native behavior verified.

nonIssues: The 3+3 assistant groups are described as original fictional assistants, not historical bishops/delegates.
The objective/outcome says receipts record delivery and explicitly does not certify current residence; this avoids a hidden stay/presence claim.
No pasted number without a preceding comma-space besides the two 240 strings was identified in the examined main objective captions.

The pre-regeneration secondary blueprint used ignored `hub`/`offsetTiles` placement keys. Root replaced them with `originHub`, `receivingHub`, and `observationHubs`; generated secondary entities/zones now carry concrete positions and the schema generation rejects unknown keys.
The earlier side-7 “voluntary evacuee groups” phrasing was replaced with “original voluntary wayfarers”; do not treat the pre-correction phrasing as current player text.

recommendationNotes: Review the two exact overlaps between separate optional destination circles, and the main account-note start position coincident with an optional viewpoint zone. They may be intentional shared local areas; this audit does not infer a defect.
The regenerated optional text now distinguishes wayfarers from the main assistant cohorts. Retain the corrected comma spacing and readable recipient phrasing.
Treat the unchanged SVG as an empty schematic route layout, not a geographic terrain map or a certification that the proposed land links are traversable; optional secondary locations are not drawn.
